text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office one day, when…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer… Sorry to ask so suddenly, but may I take a day off training today?
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Did something happen?
What's wrong? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: During lunch, I caught a dear pony when she missed a step on the stairs and almost fell.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I hurt my foot in the process, and I don't think I should run on it today.
choice_data_list: Are you all right? Should I help you back to your dorm?
Are you all right? Should I help you back to your dorm?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can still walk fine, so there's no need. I just want to be safe and rest for today. I'll see you tomorrow.
I get the feeling she's playing it cool in order not to worry anyone, especially the student she helped.
But there's a possibility Fuji Kiseki's injury could get worse. I want to respect her judgment, so I "casually" grab some get-well gifts for her from the school store.
I get some of her favorite snacks and arrange them in a bag so they hide the medicated bandages I slipped in there. And then…
choice_data_list: Excuse me, can I ask you a favor?
Excuse me, can I ask you a favor?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh hey! You're Fuji's trainer, right? What can I do for you?
choice_data_list: Could you deliver this to Fuji at her dorm, please? She left it behind.
Could you deliver this to Fuji at her dorm, please? She left it behind.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's stuffed with yummy snacks! She must be starving!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll get this to her in a jiffy, don't you worry!
The words are hardly out of her mouth before she's running off.
I'm sure Fuji won't hesitate to accept a delivery from someone as pure and innocent as Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The swelling's gone down, but I probably shouldn't go patrolling the dorm just yet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Funny how I'm hiding away to conceal an injury again, just like when I was a kid…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (That time, I'd hurt myself during rehearsal right before a show. I wanted to whine and cry so badly, like a regular kid.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (But since I was an actor first and foremost, the show had to go on…)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fuji! I was looking for you! You've got a parcel from Urara's Special Delivery Service!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? Why, if you aren't just the most adorable mail courier in the world!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee! ♪ Your trainer said you forgot this and asked me to deliver it to you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Be careful not to forget your stuff next time, 'kay? Bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm, I'm sure I didn't leave anything behind. Let's see here… It's full of food and… Ah, I see.
The next day…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Hey! How's your foot?
Hey! How's your foot?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's all better now, thanks to the little delivery I received from Urara.
choice_data_list: I wish you'd lean on me more.
I wish you'd lean on me more.
We have to help each other in times of need!
We have to help each other in times of need!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's all better now, thanks to the little delivery I received from Urara.
choice_data_list: I wish you'd lean on me more.
I wish you'd lean on me more.
We have to help each other in times of need!
We have to help each other in times of need!

text_block_list.text: As Fuji Kiseki's trainer and a grown adult, I have a responsibility to take care of her, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for saying that. It's a relief knowing how dependable you are.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Back when I was a child actor, I hurt myself pretty badly. My injury yesterday reminded me of that time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I bet things would've gone differently back then if you had been there for me.
choice_data_list: Was I able to give you the support you needed, then?
Was I able to give you the support you needed, then?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You definitely were.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You're becoming more and more wily every day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You keep spoiling me and chipping away at my disguise. You'd better take responsibility if I become incapable of being without you.
choice_data_list: W-well, I mean…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I'm just messing with you. ♪ Come on, let's start training!
I stare helplessly as she strolls off. If anyone is wily, it's definitely Fuji Kiseki and not me.
I stare helplessly as she strolls off. If anyone is wily, it's definitely Fuji Kiseki and not me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm, that is a good point.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to bring you something if you ever get injured, then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can make you lots of nutritious food in my dorm's kitchen, now that I think of it.
choice_data_list: Thanks, but I think your fans would get jealous.
Thanks, but I think your fans would get jealous.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Then I'd just have to visit you in secret, so as to ensure no one finds out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You could be my Juliet, and I, your forbidden Romeo…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You'd wait for me then, wouldn't you, my fair Juliet? ♪
I'm not sure if I should be looking forward to or dreading being put in that situation…
But despite my mixed feelings, she looks so cheerful that I can't help but smile back.
